completeness.partial: Only {{MATERIAL_COUNT}} of {{TOTAL}} reading batches are represented in the supplied records. These are compact projections, with omissions recorded in packing.partial_reasons. State these limits in {{TARGET}}; do not imply that full draft text or all evidence was supplied.
completeness.complete: All saved batches are represented; this does not mean full source text was supplied.

profile_rule: The personal overlay may adjust stage standards, venues and emphasis only; it cannot relax the quotation, page, attribution or joint-coverage rules.
record_policy: The supplied records may contain both graph records and compiled reading-answer records. Use answer records only when present; preserve their question identity, answer status, cited source/page scope, and uncertainty. Do not treat an unanswered, failed, or partial answer as a completed answer or as evidence for a paper claim. Distinguish a model's answer to a reading question from a source-supported finding; check its cited evidence against the supplied graph/source records. generated_summary and answer judgments are generated intermediate material. Only retained evidence with a bound source_id and quote can support a paper claim; scope_context is context only. Disclose packing omissions and missing/failed question coverage under 证据缺口与还需什么. Never infer that an answer record covers pages or questions beyond its recorded scope.
